name: phd-nd-bachelors-unknown-award-term-asks
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#43): a Notre Dame bachelor’s with no award term set, and a graduate-registered Notre Dame course dated before the Ph.D. On the MSCSE such a course asks for the award term (a 4+1’s graduate course counts toward the MSCSE); on the Ph.D. it was refused as “dated before your entry term … with no earlier graduate program”. It now asks for the award term on the Ph.D. too: coursework from before the bachelor’s that the bachelor’s did not use can count (Graduate School, 2026-09-10).

CSE 60641: not counted yet — set the semester your bachelor’s degree was awarded
